history: The first pass stopped at D3: the receipt status carried no finalization lease (v1) and no storage job outcome (v2). The lead then assigned the additive contract and status fields to this task.
what: A resumed receipt left 'finalizing' by a crash is finalized once more when its status shows the finish is no longer held: v1 when leaseExpiresAt has passed, v2 when finalization.jobStatus is failed, stale or cancelled. The request uses the receipt's guard, a new request key and the same SHA-256; at most one extra finalize per resume; the server's rules decide it.

server.contract: LargeUploadStatusSchema: top-level leaseExpiresAt (ISO datetime, nullable); finalization.jobStatus (queued|running|succeeded|failed|stale|cancelled) and finalization.jobError (nullable), both optional
server.status: leaseExpiresAt from usp_source_uploads.lease_expires_at; for v2 with body.storageJobId, one primary-key read: SELECT status,error FROM jobs WHERE id=$1 AND operation='large-original-storage'; omitted when the row is absent
server.rulesChanged: none: finalize, abort and cleanup unchanged

studio.finishAgain: runUpload: a resumed receipt opened in 'finalizing' is followed by status; when finishReleased(receipt) holds, the words 'The last finish was interrupted; finishing the upload again.' are shown and finalize is sent once; following continues on its answer
studio.refusal: the existing guarded wait: the server's words in the stopped line, with the existing Cancel upload
studio.words: upload-model.ts uploadWords shows the verifying words when set; the verifying phase clears earlier words (one line outside the owned files, needed to show D2's words)

inputs.note: The interrupted finish is a server state, reached here through a fake pool and a fake transport. The Studio cases use a test_only 16 MiB + 1 byte file of zeros made in the test. The existing real-file resume tests (Niagara 4 parts, NYC 6 parts) still pass through the changed path.
cases: server: v1 receipt with an expired lease states leaseExpiresAt and reads no job; v1 without a lease states null
server: v2 receipt states jobStatus 'failed' and jobError from one jobs read; a missing job row omits them; a v2 receipt with no job id reads no job
studio: v1 expired lease, one more finalize with {requestKey, expectedRevision 12, expectedCaseRevision 3, sha256}, ends retained, D2 words shown
studio: v1 live lease, followed by status only, no finalize
studio: v2 job failed while finalizing, one more finalize; a second failed status does not send another
studio: a refused finish again shows the server's words; Cancel upload aborts once

checks.studioReview: by hand: no new control; the D2 words appear in the existing status line; Cancel upload unchanged

gaps.what: Studio compares leaseExpiresAt with its own clock. If the browser clock runs ahead of the server, the extra finalize can arrive while the lease is still live; the server answers busy, Studio shows those words, and Try again or Cancel upload stays with the officer.
